units: <cite ref="Yoma 67a:3">Yoma 67ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. 2 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) <he>זימנין דגְמִישׁ רישיה ולא חזי ליה</he> sometimes the animal’s head (in falling) is bent, and he (the man) cannot see the chord.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="C01070">same</cite>. Ib. ed. <he>זימנין דג׳ ליה לרישיה ולאו אדעתיה</he> the animal may bend its head, and the man may not think of looking after the chord.
